page.overview:
Who is Al Herman?

Al Herman (born 15 March 1926 and died 18 June 1960) was an American racecar driver who participated in the Indianapolis 500 from to , when it was part of the Formula One championship. His best finish was 7th place at the 1955 Indianapolis 500.

He was killed in a first lap accident while racing in a dirt midget car race at the West Haven Speedway.
